title: Follow-up: ADR 0002 says the whole 0-7 exit family is in one EXIT_CODES map
description: Filed from the #71 review (Opus reviewer unit, APPROVED, non-blocking nit outside GCLI-21). docs/adr/0002-adopt-the-opum-command-contract.md lines 67-69 still say the full 0-7 exit-code family is in one frozen EXIT_CODES map. EXIT_CODES covers only the GlyphErrorType codes 2-7; EXIT_OK and EXIT_UNCAUGHT are separate constants combined by exitCodeTaxonomy() in src/contract.ts. CLAUDE.md now points readers to this ADR. The ADR is accepted, so correct it with a dated amendment note rather than rewriting the body. Not started.

acceptanceCriteria.text: ADR 0002 carries a dated amendment note saying EXIT_CODES is the one GlyphErrorType-to-code map for codes 2-7, with EXIT_OK and EXIT_UNCAUGHT separate and exitCodeTaxonomy() combining them; the original body text is not rewritten.
lore check --strict passes on the change.

implementationNotes: 2026-11-18: ADR 0002 gains a dated amendment section (EXIT_CODES covers 2-7; EXIT_OK and EXIT_UNCAUGHT separate; exitCodeTaxonomy() combines them); body untouched. lore check --strict: 8 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings.
finalSummary: ADR 0002 amended with a dated section: EXIT_CODES is the one GlyphErrorType-to-code map for 2-7, EXIT_OK and EXIT_UNCAUGHT are separate, exitCodeTaxonomy() combines them. Landed as opum-ai/glyph-cli#90, squash ec15ad45a79adf97d2e7db3d3ff60a9e7ddb403f, round-2 review approved at 00db3f7.
